verdict.rationale: Granola documents pre-meeting briefs that surface open threads, relevant context, and agenda points prepared overnight before a call, plus Chat/search to recall details across past meetings — directly matching the founder's need to walk in prepped. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm the brief surfaces 'past meetings with the same people' specifically (person-based history) versus general context/agenda, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the pre-meeting brief feature's real-world accuracy. missing for 10: explicit person-based meeting history matching, independent user validation of pre-meeting brief quality, and detail on how far back or how many past meetings are referenced.
